stages.name: Preparation
stages.aim: Compress the material and send it. First exposure happens at home, at the student's own pace.

stages.name: Intelligent Diagnose
stages.aim: Build a gap map, not a grade. What do they actually know?

stages.name: Knowledge Building
stages.aim: Close the flagged gaps, then model one richer example, thinking out loud.

stages.name: Practice
stages.aim: Guided, then independent — with feedback that arrives in seconds, not days.

stages.name: Production / B — Proof-Mastery Gate
stages.aim: A genuinely new situation. AI enters here — as a critic, never as an author.

stages.name: Mastery Gate
stages.aim: One individual task that decides the next path for each student.

stages.name: Smart Production
stages.aim: A final product the student is willing to put their name on.
